title: Winding Ascent to Raised Arch Terrace
description: One static classical ruin-path scene, one scene and zero new independent models. A complete self-reviewed three-quarter winding stone stair rises from the low scene floor to a raised terrace; one complete original thirteen-voussoir arch stands on that upper terrace. All two original meshes and3000 oriented triangles retain unit scale and per-face opaque PBR; only full translations and exact90degree signed-axis rotation of the arch are applied. A single68triangle closed scene-only ground/terrace union supplies the two elevations. Its upper plane matches the actual highest tread and both complete arch soles; the stair outer high end meets the platform side without a floating gap or raised-platform fill of its open central recess. Total3meshes3068tri7materials. This is an ascending and turning two-level route, not the earlier flat baffled twin-arch path or column rest plaza. Static visual arrangement only: no handrails, barriers, humans, actual navigation, accessible route, historical reconstruction, structural bearing, engineered construction, installation or pedestrian safety suitability. The added terrace is scene support, not separately counted as a new model.
